verdict.rationale: Kimi has its own model API, compatible with the OpenAI and Anthropic protocols, with console-managed keys and use in agent tools, so core chat and coding inference is programmatic. However, the probe finds no public API for the assistant app itself; the API is a separate Open Platform product. UI features such as PPT assistant, deep research, agent web-building and deploy, memory, scheduled tasks, plugins/skills and Kimi Claw have no documented API equivalents. A community report also says API parameters are restricted and web search is not recommended for production. Missing for 10: API coverage of assistant-app features (agent mode, deep research, PPT, memory, scheduled tasks, skills), a documented UI-to-API parity commitment, and API parameter flexibility matching the UI.
